device_path.description: Path to the IPMI device node (e.g., /dev/ipmi0 for kernel interface).

watchdog_enabled.description: Enable or disable kernel watchdog timer support.

watchdog_pretimeout.description: Seconds before watchdog reset when pre-timeout interrupt is triggered (set to 0 to disable).

watchdog_timeout.description: Watchdog timeout in seconds (0 = use hardware default).

event_logging_enabled.description: Enable logging of System Event Log (SEL) entries to files.

sel_max_size_kb.description: Maximum size (KB) of SEL log file before rotation.

sel_max_files_retained.description: Number of rotated SEL log files to retain.

lan_enabled.description: Enable or disable IPMI LAN (RMCP) interface configuration.

lan_configs.description: List of LAN interface configurations (one per interface). Item schema is preserved from existing schema.

pidfile_path.description: Path to write the daemon PID file.
